Package fr.univpoitiers.core.grid

Class Grid

java.lang.Object
fr.univpoitiers.core.grid.Grid
public class Grid extends Object
Represents the Sudoku game board, handling cells, board dimensions, constraint verification (rows, columns, sub-blocks), and candidate note updates.

    • checkValidValues

      public boolean checkValidValues(int pos, int value)
      Checks whether a value can be placed at the given position: it must not already be present in the same row, column, or sub-block.
      Parameters:
      pos - the cell position (1D index)
      value - the value to place (from 1 up to the maximum number of possible values)
      Returns:
      true if the value satisfies all three constraints, false otherwise (including if the value is out of bounds, e.g., 0 for an empty cell)
